# endpointcentral_mdm_group (Data Source)

Looks up an existing MDM group by exact name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "endpointcentral_mdm_group" "virtual" {
  name = "lab-devices"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Exact group name.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `id` (String) Group ID.
- `member_ids` (Set of String) Device IDs in the group.
